checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: stop an older build from overwriting a newer save version, preserving the unsupported record byte-for-byte per G-001

impact_assessment.why: G-001 says a loader refuses a version it does not support without modifying or quarantining it. Today loadProgress returns blank for version 2, then the first save normalizes and writes version 1. A played probe seeded version 2 with a FUTURE profile and futureOnly field; after one First Light clear the record became version 1, the profile reset and futureOnly vanished.
impact_assessment.benefits: A future-version save survives an older cached page or website build; the current record stays byte-for-byte intact while the game remains playable read-only in memory; corrupt records can still be replaced as before.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: saveProgress gains a refuse-to-write branch; dependency: none; concurrency: single-threaded localStorage; state: no change to v1 saves, no migration, no quarantine; a future save cannot be progressed in this build.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Two progress tests (newer version preserved, corrupt record still replaceable), a before/after Playwright probe that seeds version 2 and plays First Light, and the existing round-trip tests for v1.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented: saveProgress refuses to write when the stored record has a newer integer version, keeps corrupt records replaceable, adds newer-version and corrupt-recovery tests, README save wording and ADR-013

[1/4] Plan: keep a Next chamber or Episode index action in the game foot after a victory dialog is dismissed, so a solved board is never a dead end

impact_assessment.why: After First Light clears, pressing Escape or the dialog close button leaves the game screen with 1 move, 1/1 receivers and status 'Relay closed. Chamber complete.'; the next chamber is unlocked but there is no forward button, and clicking the completed board does nothing. The only route to Split Decision is back through the episode index.
impact_assessment.benefits: A dismissed victory dialog stays recoverable: the foot shows Next chamber, or Episode index on the finale, until the player restarts or leaves. Dismissal keeps its escape hatch and the modal flow is unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds one data-ui handle and a foot control; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: action derives from the existing victory result, hidden on start/reset; layout: the foot grows around 40px on desktop and stacks on mobile.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure postVictoryAction() cases, required-control coverage, updateGameView hiding on start/reset, before/after screenshots after Escape from the same First Light state, a played dismiss-then-Next run that lands on Split Decision, and the 18-level regression.

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Implemented: pure postVictoryAction helper with three tests, hidden next-step button in the game foot, updateGameView/finishLevel/previewVictory wiring, click starts next or index, README and ADR-014

[1/3] Plan: make save feedback honest in the profile and the victory modal when a write is refused or fails

impact_assessment.why: With a read-only future-version save, editing the callsign reports 'Callsign saved.' and choosing a sigil reports 'Sigil updated.' although localStorage still holds FUTURE/helix; clearing First Light shows a normal 3-star victory with no warning while the result is not stored. The player is told progress happened when it did not.
impact_assessment.benefits: Every profile write and every chamber clear reports its real persistence state; a future-version or quota-restricted save can no longer masquerade as stored progress, while normal v1 writes keep their success messages.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: victory result gains saveFailed and the modal body gains a warning; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save-format change, still read-only for newer versions; layout: one extra fine-print line in the victory modal.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure saveStatusMessage(saved, success) cases, source-verified profile status after real Save and sigil clicks, a future-save victory warning, a normal-v1 success control, and the 18-level regression.

[1/3] Plan: show the current star pace in the moves HUD so every move tells the player whether three stars are still reachable

impact_assessment.why: The HUD shows moves against par but not the rating those moves would earn. A player who overshoots par by one only discovers the lost 3-star run on the victory card; starsFor already defines the boundary at par and par+2.
impact_assessment.benefits: Three small stars next to the move count dim as the run crosses par and par+2, giving immediate, glanceable feedback without a new panel or modal; the aria label states the pace for screen readers.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: adds a data-cue marker and reuses starsMarkup; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: derived from moves and par, reset with the session; layout: the moves metric grows by about 30px and may wrap at 320px.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Static HUD marker test, starsFor boundaries already covered, before/after HUD screenshots at moves 0/5/8 on Double Down, a real five- and eight-click run reading the star count and aria label, mobile width checks, and the 18-level regression.

[1/3] Plan: distinguish earned and unearned stars by shape, not only color, so forced-colors and color-impaired players can read the pace

impact_assessment.why: In forced-colors mode the HUD renders all three stars with the same glyph and computed color rgb(0,0,0), even though earned is [true,true,false]; the same filled glyph is used for both states everywhere. The star pace added in cycle 8 is therefore unreadable in Windows High Contrast and weak for color-impaired users.
impact_assessment.benefits: Earned stars stay filled and unearned stars become outlined, so every star row in the HUD, chamber index and victory card carries its state without color; forced-colors screenshots become unambiguous.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: star markup moves to a pure module and unearned glyphs change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no score change; layout: the outline glyph is the same width in the supporting fonts.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure starsMarkup/starLabel tests for 0/2/3 stars, forced-colors and normal-mode HUD screenshots at the same Double Down moves-5 state, a real click run reading filled/outline counts, a reduced-motion audit, and the 18-level regression.
